Broken by a devastating loss and drowning in debt, a washed-up former champion enters a brutal, underground bare-knuckle tournament for one final shot at redemption. Driven by an unlikely coach and an unyielding will to survive, he claws his way back from the absolute abyss to face the undefeated titan of the heavyweight division. In a climax that defines a generation, he steps into the ring not just for the championship belt, but to reclaim his shattered soul.
